biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend applies through YOUR unique referral link, becomes a member, opens checking, and receives $250+ in qualifying payroll direct deposits within 60 days. A friend who joins but never sets up direct deposit earns you nothing — and referrals made in quick succession can be flagged as abuse and denied.
catches: Referred friend must: be 18+ and a California resident; apply online using the referring member's unique referral link; become a Golden 1 member (new members only — no Golden 1 checking ownership in the last 24 months); open a traditional savings share account ($1 minimum) and a checking account; and receive qualifying direct deposits totaling $250+ within 60 days of account opening.

Qualifying direct deposit = electronic paycheck/pension/Social Security deposit to the Golden 1 checking account. Zelle, Venmo, wire transfers, teller/ATM deposits, and online/mobile banking transfers do NOT qualify.
Referrer capped at $400 total (8 qualified referrals) during the promotional period April 8, 2026 – December 31, 2026.
$50 Visa egift card emailed within 15 business days of qualification verification; accounts must be open and in good standing at verification.
Golden 1 may deny rewards for suspected collusion, fraud, or referrals in quick succession; fiduciary and business accounts are ineligible.
Both parties responsible for taxes; Golden 1 will report as income if required by law.
Promotion cannot be combined with any other promotions; terms may be changed at any time.

steps: Get your unique referral link as an existing Golden 1 member.
Share the link with friends and family (California residents, 18+).
Your friend applies for Golden 1 membership online using your link and becomes a member.
Your friend opens a traditional savings share account ($1 minimum) and a checking account.
Your friend receives qualifying direct deposits totaling $250+ into the checking account within 60 days.
A $50 Visa egift card is emailed to you within 15 business days of qualification verification.
timing: $50 Visa egift card emailed no later than 15 business days after direct deposit verification, provided accounts are open and in good standing.
when_cash_arrives: $50 Visa egift card emailed no later than 15 business days after direct deposit verification, provided accounts are open and in good standing. Roughly a month from the trigger event to cash in hand.
maximize: Trigger the clock early: have your friend complete qualifying activity (direct deposit, debit transactions) in the first days of the window.
Route a real payroll direct deposit (not Zelle/P2P transfers, which most programs exclude) as early as possible - payroll timing is usually the gating step.
If any-amount direct deposit qualifies, a small recurring ACH can trigger it - check the program's 'qualifying deposit' definition first.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the payout window itself is 3-4 weeks after qualification - there is no expedited track.
